cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Invite your invisible client to my wedding, and her family. I taught you to make room for people; one spare place is a timid start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They walk through walls. They won't stay for cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hire a ballroom that follows them. You used to chase guests with a tray; now let the room do the chasing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can get one that splits when they wander apart.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's more like my pupil. Order a cake that multiplies with it; I'm promising every room the first slice.

reason: Make the former pupil relationship change the practical request, correction or interpretation. Preserve the useful original causal chain while repairing remote-audience knowledge and explicit bowl orientation.
